docs.title: TEXAS CHICKEN
docs.text:
Serving really good chicken for those who enjoy really good chicken. The Texas Way. 

At Malaysia’s Texas Chicken™, they deliver authentic traditions, bold tastes and straightforward, consistent food you can trust. After all, Texas Chicken more than fresh-fried chicken in Malaysia. The crisp, satisfying bite of a meal earned through hard work. The feeling of community that comes through shared moments and simple pleasures.

docs.title: THE CHICKEN RICE SHOP
docs.text:
To dine with The Chicken Rice Shop is to rediscover the wholesome taste of Hainanese and Malaysian cuisines. They take pride in being truly made in Malaysia with our chain of HALAL family restaurants that serve guests throughout the region. 

The Chicken Rice Shop serves traditionally prepared steamed, roasted, honey barbecued and soy sauce chicken as its signature products. These signature dishes are served with fluffy chicken flavoured rice cooked to perfection from a recipe passed down through the generations, originating from Hainan Island. The Chicken Rice Shop menu also features more than 25 other local favourites such as our Hainanese Curry Chicken, Famous Stuffed Fish Balls, and Penang Rojak - just to mention a few.

docs.title: THE GREEN PARTY
docs.text:
The Green Party is a retail store, primarily operating in Malaysia and Singapore, that focuses on trendy lifestyle goods with a focus on green and nature-inspired products. 

They aim to provide a "One Stop Shopping" experience with a wide range of products, including household goods, collectibles, and gifts, while promoting sustainable living.

docs.title: TINY MOLLYFANTASY & KIDS BOX
docs.text:
Mollyfantasy is a world full of laughter, fun and excitement for families that provide a safe indoor entertainment centre originating from Japan.

Kid’s Box is an all-new store by Aeon Fantasy, which is derived from the kidzooona concept pioneered in Japan. Kid’s Box provides great playtime for children with exciting toys, game machines, and play equipment. It provides quality and memorable moments within the confines of a well-crafted space.

Urban Republic is a lifestyle technology store offering a wide range of smartphones, gadgets, accessories and smart devices.

docs.title: VISUAL OPTICAL
docs.text:
VISUAL OPTICAL is a trusted optical retailer offering professional eye care services and a wide range of eyewear solutions. 

Established as part of VISUAL OPTICAL SDN. BHD., the brand has been serving the Kluang community since 1995, providing eye examinations, prescription glasses, contact lenses, and quality eye care products. 

With experienced optometrists and a focus on customer satisfaction, Visual Optical combines reliable service with stylish and functional eyewear for everyday needs.

docs.title: VIVO
docs.text:
vivo is a global technology brand known for its innovative smartphones and user-focused design. 

The company offers a range of devices that combine sleek aesthetics with advanced features such as high-quality cameras, powerful performance, and immersive displays. 

With a strong focus on innovation and everyday usability, vivo aims to enhance the mobile experience for users around the world.

docs.title: WATSONS
docs.text:
Watsons Malaysia is the leading health and beauty retailer with more than 550 Watsons stores and growing in the country serving the needs of all Malaysians. 

Watsons continues to inspire our customers to enjoy life to the fullest and set the standards in the health, wellness and beauty market, providing personalised advice in health, beauty and personal care on top of its market-leading product ranges, making customers LOOK GOOD, FEEL GREAT every day.

docs.title: XES PREMIUM
docs.text:
XES Premium is a contemporary retail brand offering a curated selection of lifestyle products, including footwear, bags, and accessories. Known for its stylish designs and quality craftsmanship, XES Premium combines comfort with modern trends to suit everyday needs.

The brand focuses on providing versatile and affordable fashion choices for individuals seeking both style and functionality.

docs.title: XIAOMI
docs.text:
Xiaomi is a global technology company known for offering high-quality smart devices at accessible prices. 

Founded in 2010, Xiaomi designs and produces a wide range of products, including smartphones, smart home devices, wearables, and lifestyle gadgets. With a focus on innovation and user-centric design, Xiaomi aims to make advanced technology available to everyone, creating a connected ecosystem that enhances everyday life.

docs.title: YFS CONCEPT STORE
docs.text: YFS Concept Store is a fashion retailer in Malaysia specializing in clothing for the entire family. They offer a wide range of apparel, from basic garments to trendy, stylish pieces for all ages. The store aims to provide a comfortable shopping experience with a focus on high-quality, competitively priced fashion.

docs.title: YOUNG HEARTS

Young Hearts is a fun-loving, high-spirited, and feminine brand made for the young—and the young at heart.

At Young Hearts, we’re here to inspire you to love life—with passion, self-expression, and pure enjoyment. 💕

docs.title: ZERO
docs.text: Zero Healthcare is a wellness brand dedicated to helping people live healthier, stress-free lives through innovative and reliable health equipment designed for everyday comfort.

docs.title: ZUS COFFEE
docs.text:
From the beginning, the dream was always to deliver specialty coffee as a daily necessity for ALL to enjoy. For many, specialty coffee is often seen as a luxury, something you treat yourself to on special occasions. ZUS wanted to change this perception.

Every ZUS COFFEE is a cup of clean, consistent and well-handled coffee. With the best quality ingredients, high-level coffee brewing technology and innovative business model, they are evolving the concept of coffee consumption to make specialty coffee affordable for everyone, everyday.

With over 39 million cups delivered to date, they only have the beloved ZUSsies to thank for all the achievements thus far.
